description: Six ways of processing a voltage over time: two stages of sample and hold, track and hold both ways round, and two slew limiters

params.text: Sets the slew rate in milliseconds per volt, from 1ms to 10 seconds for each volt of change
Acts as the gate for as long as it is held down

inputs.text: Adds to the slew rate, each volt doubling it
The gate that drives the sampling, tracking and slew limiting

outputs.text: Takes the input voltage on each trigger and holds it until the next one
The voltage held before the last trigger, one place back in a two-step shift register
Passes the input while the gate is low and holds the last voltage while the gate is high
Passes the input while the gate is high and holds the last voltage while the gate is low
The input held to the slew rate, so it cannot change faster than that; while the gate is high it jumps to the input and follows it
The input held to the slew rate only while the gate is high, and passed through the rest of the time; the limiting starts 1ms after the gate rises
